Ilhan Omar's Home Raided Amid Immigration Fraud Investigation

Federal agents raided the Washington D.C. home of Congresswoman Ilhan Omar as part of an immigration fraud investigation. Omar stated she would "not be silenced" and called the raid the "latest escalation" in President Donald Trump's "intimidation" campaign.
